FZRA risk where rain falls into

svg.text: distance from the surface front (warm sector ← | → ahead)
Passage sequence (observer ahead of the front):
Ci → Cs (halo) → As (watery sun) → Ns with steady rain, lowering base, poor visibility · pressure falls steadily, wind backs and freshens.
At passage: wind veers, temperature and dew point rise, rain eases to drizzle, pressure fall stops · warm sector: St/Sc, drizzle, haze.
Typical values: slope ≈ 1:150 · rain belt ≈ 300 km (≈ 200 nm) ahead · cirrus up to ≈ 1 000 km ahead · moves ≈ 10–15 kt. Cf. Met Office “Weather fronts”; Penn State METEO 3, warm fronts.
